_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Looking for real churches near there

description: List real church buildings and congregations within 250 km of a place, nearest first, merged live from churches on The Living Bread and an open worldwide directory of about 120,000 churches. Use when someone wants a church to attend ("Baptist churches in Dallas", "a parish near Manchester"). Not for one known church's record (church), for events or services at a time (find_gatherings_near, gatherings_tonight), or for small groups to join (communities_to_join). Needs lat+lng or city, else an error. Location precision is city level: names, city and distance only, never street addresses or contacts. Zero results return count 0 with the nearest church held, if any. The search words (no user id) are logged anonymously. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

city.description: A city, region or country, used when there are no coordinates: "Dallas", "Lagos", "Greater London". Geocoded to its centre.

denomination.description: Optional tradition filter, one lowercase word: "baptist", "catholic", "methodist", "pentecostal", "orthodox", "anglican".

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, only if the person shared their location. Must be paired with lng; coordinates win over city.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, paired with lat.

name: find_churches_near

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

churches.description: Nearest first: name, city-level place, distance in km, denomination when known, whether the church is on The Living Bread, its open-data page, and an id (lb:church:<country>/<slug> ids work with church and fetch).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

count.description: Number of churches returned; 0 when none is held within 250 km.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

find_a_church.description: Link to the live church finder map.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

honest.description: Present when count is 0: what the empty result means.

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

nearest_we_hold.description: When count is 0, the nearest church held beyond 250 km, if any.

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Find churches near a place
